title: DeathTP
description: Teleport back to where you last died
body:
# DeathTP

A lightweight Minecraft plugin that allows players to teleport back to their last death location.

## Features

* Teleport to your most recent death location
* Simple and easy-to-use commands
* Lightweight and optimized
* Works great for survival servers
* Minimal setup required
* Works well with Death chest plugins like AxGraves

## Commands
`/back` - Teleport to your last death location

DeathTP is designed to provide a simple and reliable way for players to return to where they died without unnecessary complexity.
